metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the Purdue University Online Course Production team.

plugins.name: cp-accessibility
plugins.description: Checks HTML course content against WCAG 2.2 AA and reports each issue with its success criterion.

plugins.name: course-production-agents
plugins.description: Turns a folder of faculty content into a course map, a media plan, and one Brightspace package per module or week, with infographics that carry full text descriptions.
